import json, sys, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from runner import *

def rc_and_body(data):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=data, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode().strip()

cases = [
    ("empty", b""),
    ("just-ws", b"   \n\t "),
    ("array", b"[1,2,3]"),
    ("null", b"null"),
    ("string", b'"hello"'),
    ("number", b'42'),
    ("two-docs", b'{"version":1} {"version":1}'),
    ("trailing-tokens", b'{} junk'),
    ("extra-root-key", json.dumps({**base(), "extra": 1}).encode()),
    ("missing-rounds", b'{"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[]}'),
    ("dup-root-key", b'{"version":1,"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[0,0],"edges":[],"rounds":[]}'),
    ("no-edges-no-rounds", json.dumps(base(n=2, capacity=[1,1])).encode()),
    ("nan", b'{"version":NaN,"n":2,"capacity":[0,0],"edges":[],"rounds":[]}'),
    ("inf", b'{"version":Infinity,"n":2,"capacity":[0,0],"edges":[],"rounds":[]}'),
    ("neginf", b'{"version":-Infinity,"n":2,"capacity":[0,0],"edges":[],"rounds":[]}'),
    ("bad-utf8", b'{"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[0,0],"edges":[],"x":"\xff\xfe","rounds":[]}'),
    ("trailing-ws-valid", (json.dumps(base(n=2, capacity=[1,1])) + "\n\n  ").encode()),
    ("leading-ws-valid", ("   " + json.dumps(base(n=2))).encode()),
    ("control-char-in-string", b'{"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[0,0],"edges":[],"rounds":[],"x":"a\nb"}'),
    ("dup-nested-key", b'{"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[0,0],"edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"}],"rounds":[]}'),
    ("single-quote-json", b"{'version':1}"),
    ("trailing-comma", b'{"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[0,0],"edges":[],"rounds":[],}'),
    ("comment", b'{"version":1,/*c*/"n":2,"capacity":[0,0],"edges":[],"rounds":[]}'),
    ("deep-nesting", b'[' * 200000 + b']' * 200000),
]
fails = 0
for name, data in cases:

    ok = (rc == 2 and body == '{"error":"invalid-input"}') or (rc == 0 and '"error"' not in body)

    if rc != want:

print("over-2MiB:", rc, body, "expect 2/invalid")
